assignments.controllerIndices: OuterPetal_01 through OuterPetal_15 occupy indices 8 through 22 after the eight inner petals. Override Palette per petal to change its tone family.

manualControls.fill: Manually authored sRGB substrate shade for this state and tone family.
manualControls.ornament: Main gold ornament and border color.
manualControls.mainPatternIntensity: Independent emission of border and main ornament.
manualControls.sharedGlowSlider: Multiplies all emission regions. All-petals selection controls both layers.
manualControls.liveEditing: Palette asset edits refresh during Play Mode without restarting palette or artwork transitions. ScriptableObject edits persist after exiting Play Mode.

artwork.generationPromptBrief: Create one portrait 2:3 outer-petal ornament texture for a Deepavali flower. Crisp, flat orthographic 2D artwork on uniform #551024 burgundy. Use the attached flower reference for airy gold diamonds, beads and foliate decoration, and the existing inner-petal texture for related style, with a calmer composition and roughly 55% negative space. Imply a vertical leaf with its tip at the top and root at the bottom. Add a small finial about 12% from the top, mirrored scrollwork in the upper third, a restrained eight-petal central rosette, and lower droplets and diamonds. Primary ornament #FFD877 and secondary details #E99024. Do not add an enclosing border: the exact mesh contour supplies it separately. No complete flower assembly, text, shadows, bloom, perspective or 3D shading.
artwork.technicalPacking: 1024 x 2048 linear RGBA. R ornament coverage; G main/secondary blend; B neutral pigment detail; A exact UV-contour gold border, beadwork and protected rim. Generated source remains unchanged.
